name: Bauernhof Maisfeld
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Maisfeld in Schwoich is operated as a holiday residence estate comprising multiple separate residential units. The holiday apartments are modernly equipped and perfectly tailored for families and couples alike. The generous grounds feature a large garden with sunbathing lawns and comfortable outdoor seating. Schwoich is nestled in the Tyrolean Unterland near Kufstein. The scenic surroundings are ideally suited for hiking and cycling excursions in the Alpine foothills. The accommodation offers independent holiday living in a quiet rural setting, enhanced by attentive personal care from the hosts.
